news.headline: New safety regulations for motorcyclists take effect
news.summary: The government has announced updated helmet and lane safety standards for all riders starting this month.
news.content: The Ministry of Transport has introduced stricter helmet requirements and new lane-splitting guidelines designed to reduce accidents across the city. Riders are encouraged to review the new rules and update their gear accordingly.

news.headline: How to shop safely for your next motorcycle online
news.summary: Important steps to verify sellers, inspect listings, and avoid scams when buying bikes from marketplaces.
news.content: Shopping online can save you time and money, but it's essential to confirm seller credentials, check bike history, and arrange secure payment. Follow our checklist before you commit.

socialPosts.content: Rode the new mountain trail today and the views were insane. Highly recommend this route for anyone with a dual-sport bike.
First group ride with the crew this season — perfect weather, perfect grip, and the cafe stop was worth every kilometer.
Wish the roads were a bit less crowded today, but the ride was still refreshing. Who else is planning a long weekend journey?
Found this hidden coastal road — smooth asphalt, ocean breeze, and zero traffic. Perfect sunrise ride.
The new exhaust upgrade sounds amazing. Anyone else here running a similar setup?
Sunset trail ride with the crew. The last hill was tough but the finish line coffee made it worth it.
Explored a new gravel path today. The view over the valley was simply unforgettable.
Stopped by a hidden lakeside cafe after the Sunday ride. Great meet-up spot for riders.
Love how the city lights look from the river road. Night rides are the best kind of therapy.
Tomorrow morning we’re doing a sunrise route into the hills. Anyone want to join?
Checked out the classic bike meet-up yesterday. So much inspiration from the restored rides.
Late-night cafe ride and the city glow made it feel like a movie scene.
City streets are more alive with friends on two wheels. Loved the chatter and the fresh breeze.
Spent the day tuning the suspension and the bike feels so much sharper now.
Found a new spot for a quick photo shoot during the ride. The colors were unreal.

forums.title: Best route from Yangon to Bagan?
forums.author: Khin
forums.excerpt: Looking for a scenic and safe route from Yangon to Bagan, preferably with good stops along the way.

replies.author: Aung
replies.content: Take the Pyay route in the dry season. The road is smoother and there are good food stops.

replies.author: May
replies.content: Avoid the inland road during monsoon; it gets muddy. Take the highway and stop at Myinmu for a break.

replies.author: Thida
replies.content: I use Kyi Kyi Garage on 34th St. They are fast and fair with prices.

forums.title: What tires work best for mixed roads?
forums.author: Hla
forums.excerpt: Looking for a tire recommendation for routes that mix pavement and gravel.

replies.author: Nay
replies.content: Try a touring dual-sport tire with a balanced tread — it handles both surfaces well.

replies.author: Su
replies.content: I like the Pirelli Scorpion Rally STR for mixed routes; it still feels stable on asphalt.
